improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
improve.coach: It's crept up to 80% of your recent matches (65% overall). Let's make it the focus.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
improve.coach: 35% of matches, right in line with your recent form. A good one to drill.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: The net said thank you, and so do I. Shows up in 71% of your matches. That's a calling card.
